lines.zh: 我走在队伍最后，袍角拖地。
lines.en: I walk at the back of the group, robe hem dragging.

lines.zh: 我拖着法袍，一步一步逼近。
lines.en: I drag my robe forward, one step at a time.

lines.zh: 我拖着法杖走，杖尖刮着地。
lines.en: I drag my staff along, its tip scraping the ground.

lines.zh: 袍角下面，没有脚在走路。
lines.en: Under my robe hem, nothing is walking.

lines.zh: 我的召唤物，不会听你的。
我数着念珠，嘴唇一直在动。
lines.en: I count prayer beads, lips moving without pause.

lines.zh: 我伸开双臂，骨头咔咔响。
lines.en: I stretch both arms, bones cracking.

lines.zh: 我收起獠牙，慢慢朝你走。
lines.en: I retract my fangs and walk slowly toward you.
The totem is already in my hand.
tries to control player with spells
tries to attract player with magic

lines.zh: 苍白光芒在你身上闪烁！
lines.en: Pale light flickers on your body!

lines.zh: 你感到一阵冰冷的恐惧！
你的身体开始扭曲变形！
你的心跳声越来越微弱！
你的意识开始模糊不清！

lines.en: You drift in a dream-like state!
Your soul is dragged into the abyss!

lines.zh: 恐惧吞噬着你的每一寸肌肤！
你身上的光芒让它变得狂热！
lines.en: The light on you makes it frenzy!

lines.zh: 你的血肉味，让我忘了祷词。
lines.en: The smell of your flesh makes me forget the prayer.
It wants to taste your fresh flesh.
Every page of my evocation book is blank.

lines.zh: 它的触手紧紧缠住你不放。
lines.en: Its tentacles tightly wrap around you.

lines.zh: 它释放出腐蚀性的触须。
它开始吞噬周围的空气。
lines.en: It starts devouring the air around you.

lines.zh: 它发出令人作呕的嘶吼。
lines.en: It lets out a nauseating growl.

lines.zh: 它猛然撞向你，发出巨大的响声！
lines.en: It collides with you, making a loud sound!

lines.zh: 它的身体像石头一样坚硬。
lines.en: Its body is as hard as stone.

lines.zh: 它的碰撞让你头晕目眩。
我的法袍扫过你，皮肤发麻。
lines.en: My robe brushes you, and your skin prickles.

lines.zh: 它的碰撞让你难以招架。
lines.en: Its collision is hard to withstand.

lines.zh: 你被它的冲击震得站不住脚。
它的力量似乎无穷无尽。
我朝另一个紫袍身影靠近。
lines.en: I move toward another figure in purple robes.

lines.zh: 它发出吸引同伴的叫声。
lines.en: It lets out a call to attract companions.

lines.zh: 我朝林子里那个影子伸出手。
lines.en: I reach toward the shadow in the treeline.
Its voice is filled with desire.
It lets out a low growl in the darkness.
Its eyes are filled with expectation.

lines.zh: 它寻找着能够交配的对象。
lines.en: It seeks a partner for mating.
My totem has a new master.

lines.zh: 它的声音让黑夜变得更加深沉。
lines.en: Its voice makes the night even darker.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着诡异的绿光！
lines.en: Its eyes glow with an eerie green light!

lines.zh: 你听见了它嘶嘶的低语！
它的皮肤渗出黏液，恶心！

lines.en: It hisses and licks its tongue!
Its movements are slow and strange!

lines.zh: 它的呼吸声沉重如影随形！

lines.en: Its voice is full of malice!

lines.zh: 它的皮肤变得愈加苍白！
你成了它的下一个目标！
它的眼神中透露出饥饿！

lines.en: It's got you in its sights!
It's about to cast a spell!

lines.zh: 它的眼神中闪烁着疯狂！
lines.en: Its eyes are wild with madness!

lines.zh: 我的法杖先转，然后才是我。
lines.en: My staff turns first, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 附身的东西，认得你的名字。
lines.en: The thing inside me knows your name.

lines.zh: 紫光在你脚边画了个圈。
lines.en: Purple light draws a circle around your feet.

lines.zh: 我念了一句，你就被记下了。
lines.en: I speak one line, and you are recorded.

lines.zh: 唤魔者的手，现在归它指挥。
lines.en: The evoker's hands answer to it now.
It hisses and screams at you!
It's about to cast a deadly spell!
Its wand is aimed at you!

lines.zh: 它的魔杖指向你的要害！
lines.en: Its wand points at your vulnerable spot!

lines.zh: 我的咒语，会在三步后落地。
lines.en: My spell lands three steps from now.

lines.zh: 你脚下的草，正被拧成一圈。
lines.en: The grass under you is twisting into a ring.

lines.zh: 别打断我，咒文已经念到一半。
lines.en: Don't interrupt. The chant is halfway done.

lines.zh: 它替我看清了你的骨头在哪。
lines.en: It has showed me exactly where your bones are.

lines.zh: 紫光越亮，你的呼吸越浅。
lines.en: The brighter the purple, the shallower your breath.

lines.zh: 我把你的影子钉在法术中心。
lines.en: I pin your shadow at the spell's center.

lines.zh: 这一句念完，你就动不了了。
lines.en: When this line ends, you won't be able to move.

lines.zh: 我数着音节，也数着你的步。
lines.en: I count syllables, and I count your steps.

lines.zh: 我抬手，尖牙从袖口探出来。
lines.en: I raise a hand, and fangs slide from my sleeve.
Feel the power of the pale demon!

lines.zh: 唤魔者的尖牙，碰到你了。
我一爪抓来，指缝里带着紫光。
lines.en: I claw at you, violet light between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我的召唤杖指向你，地面裂开。
lines.en: I point my staff at you, and the ground splits.
My spell is about to be cast!

lines.zh: 紫光炸开，把石头掀了起来。
lines.en: Purple light bursts and throws the stones up.

lines.zh: 我的杖尖点中你的胸口。
lines.en: My staff tip taps your chest.

lines.zh: 这一击没有重量，只有寒意。
lines.en: This blow has no weight, only cold.

lines.zh: 你被自己的影子绊倒了。
法术收尾，你的皮肤发灰。
lines.en: The spell finishes, and your skin turns gray.

lines.zh: 它借我的手，撕开了空气。
lines.en: It uses my hand to tear the air open.

lines.zh: 我站在祭坛上，紫袍无风自动。
lines.en: I stand on the altar, my purple robe stirring without wind.
I am here, to be punished!

lines.zh: 洞穴深处，法杖自己立了起来。
lines.en: Deep in the cave, the staff stands up on its own.

lines.zh: 一件空袍子，慢慢有了人形。
lines.en: An empty robe slowly takes on a human shape.

lines.zh: 火燎到袍子，附身的东西叫了一声。
lines.en: Fire catches my robe and the thing inside shrieks.

lines.zh: 水中的寒气侵蚀你的灵魂！
lines.en: Chill from the water seeps into your soul!

lines.zh: 爆炸的冲击撕裂你的身体！
魔法之力侵蚀着你的灵魂！
